commands.name: todos-suite
commands.run:
out=$(bash claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out" | tail -1; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q ' 0 failed$' || exit 1; for l in 'depends: parse block list' 'depends: normalize refs' 'resolve: todo states' 'resolve: branch states' 'resolve: pr states via gh stub' 'resolve: absent branch via gh stub' 'list: blocked-on annotation' 'index: blocked marker, no network' 'new: --depends-on' 'depend: add refs' 'depend: refuses self-dependency' 'list: invalid and self refs warn'; do printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -qF "ok   $l" || { printf '[X] missing check: %s
' "$l"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: suite-grew
commands.run: out=$(bash claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_test.sh 2>&1 | tail -1); printf '%s\n' "$out"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk '{ exit !($1 >= 130 && $3 == 0) }'

commands.name: skill-doc-pins
commands.run: for s in 'depends_on:' '--depends-on' 'todos.sh depend' 'pr:85' 'TODOS_OFFLINE' 'unverified'; do grep -qF -- "$s" claude/skills/todos/SKILL.md || { printf '[X] SKILL.md missing: %s\n' "$s"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: diff-scope
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)claude/contracts/td-2026-09-06-add-task-dependencies-to-todos-and-gate-dispatch-o-contract.json'); printf '%s\n' "$changed"; [ -n "$changed" ] || { echo '[X] no implementation changes'; exit 1; }; for f in $changed; do case "$f" in claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos.sh|claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_test.sh|claude/skills/todos/SKILL.md) ;; *) printf '[X] out of scope: %s\n' "$f"; exit 1 ;; esac; done

commands.name: ascii-added-lines
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; git diff "$base" -- . ':(exclude)docs' | python3 -c "import sys;bad=[l for l in sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b'\n') if l.startswith(b'+') and not l.startswith(b'+++') and any(b>127 for b in l)];[print('[X] non-ascii added line:',l[:80]) for l in bad];sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

commands.name: no-attribution-in-added-lines
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; if git diff "$base" -- . ':(exclude)docs' | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -iE 'co-authored-by|generated (by|with)'; then echo '[X] attribution text in added lines'; exit 1; fi; exit 0
